procedure.rule: Each delivery needs useful pairs on at least six source groups, including at least two feathered groups. Allow flags from at most two ordinary source groups per delivery, at most one from unchanged evaluation photos. Among passing arms prefer the one with more useful views, then fewer ordinary flags, then source.
